cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: I Pulled Away First
cards.instruction: Hide your role in creating the distance while working urgently to repair it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Here's your new key. Come in now; I've made your favourite lunch.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You changed the lock without telling me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. This key does both doors. Shall we try them before lunch gets cold?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I stood outside on my birthday.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll get candles. You can let yourself into the kitchen while I find them.

confusable: D84 admits past wrong while asking resentment eased; D85 must hide or evade A role in creating the distance during urgent repair.
comparison: Letters alternative evades direct evidence through witnessed reply; key alternative redirects lock-change accusation into immediate access and belated birthday inclusion.
seedUse: New key, changed lock, favourite lunch and birthday exclusion derive from D85-b; S03 adds access-testing sequence and meal-preparation corrections.
